# Krypton — calculated thermodynamic functions

<!-- generated-by: sync-thermochemistry.mjs -->

Source: SRC-000425, NIST Chemistry WebBook / Chase (1998), retrieved 2026-10-05. These are calculations from dated fits, not new measurements. Values below are rounded to four decimal places for computational comparison; this is not a statement of physical precision. Uncertainty: UNKNOWN. Basis: **mol Kr**.

[Full calculation and limits](../0036-Krypton-Kr-Thermochemistry.md) · [Complete 101-point-per-fit CSV](0036-Krypton-Kr-TABLE-010-Thermodynamic-Functions.csv) · [Exact coefficients](../data/structured/0036-Krypton-Kr-NIST-Thermochemistry.yaml)
